name: Iridescence
description: Full-area WebGL2 shader background of flowing iridescent color waves that stir under the pointer, swirl on click, and can be tinted, rotated, faded at the edges and paused.
contents: Root div containing a single full-size WebGL canvas rendering a fragment shader
behavior: Animated iridescent color pattern driven by time and speed
Pattern shifts toward the pointer and a stir field distorts it as the pointer moves over the page
Soft highlight sheen follows the pointer
Click or tap creates a decaying swirl at that point, up to 6 at once
Rendering pauses when scrolled out of view and when idle
Canvas resizes with its container, pixel ratio capped at 2 and scaled by resolution
With reduced motion enabled the animation, stir and click swirl are disabled
editableByProps: Tint color as RGB array (0 to 1) or any CSS color string
Animation speed, pause, pattern scale, rotation, detail and warp
Hue shift, saturation, brightness, contrast, grain and overall opacity
Pointer reaction, stir strength, sheen, click swirl and edge fade
Render resolution and container size through className or style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the pattern or color math of the effect
Change the number or lifetime of click swirls
Change pointer stir brush size or strength
Change how fast the stir distortion fades

fixed: Root is h-full w-full, so the parent must have a defined height or the background collapses; use className or style to size or position it (for example absolute inset-0)
Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unsupported or the shader fails to compile
Listens for pointer events on window, so pointer reaction and click swirl work even when content sits above the canvas
Detail is clamped to 1 to 24, grain, fade and opacity to 0 to 1, resolution to 0.1 to 2
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by freezing animation and disabling stir and swirl
Sizes from its container and handles resize, works on mobile, but heavy shader detail may be slow on low-end phones
